title: SiegeCore
description: SiegeCore is a Minecraft PvP mod focused on combat and customizable utilities.
body:
# SiegeCore
SiegeCore is a lightweight Minecraft utility mod focused on multiplayer quality-of-life, gameplay customization, and performance improvements. It adds configurable client-side and server-supported systems designed to improve the overall multiplayer experience while keeping vanilla gameplay familiar and unobtrusive. Whether you're playing on supported servers or using the mod independently, SiegeCore provides tools and enhancements that make gameplay smoother, cleaner, and more customizable. ## Features **HUD & Visual Customization** Custom HUD elements and interface improvements Visual enhancements designed to improve clarity during gameplay Adjustable settings for a personalized multiplayer experience **Gameplay Utilities** Built-in utility systems for easier navigation and interaction Configurable gameplay assistance and convenience features Multiplayer-focused tools that improve accessibility and usability without heavily altering vanilla mechanics **Multiplayer Quality-of-Life** Server-supported systems for enhanced multiplayer functionality Improved interaction with compatible SiegeCore-enabled servers Streamlined commands and utilities for supported gameplay systems Commands **_SiegeCore includes a /siege command system used to access supported gameplay utilities and server-integrated features._**
Spoiler Example Commands /siege start /siege loadout /siege map
**Available commands and functionality may vary depending on server support and installed modules.** ### Server Support Some SiegeCore features are designed to integrate with compatible multiplayer servers. Certain systems, commands, or gameplay mechanics may require server-side support to function properly. ### Compatibility SiegeCore is designed to work alongside supported Minecraft mod loaders and multiplayer environments. The mod aims to remain lightweight and compatible with modpacks without introducing major gameplay overhauls. ### Important Information SiegeCore is not a content expansion mod and does not add new dimensions, mobs, or progression systems. Some features shown in screenshots or videos may only function on supported servers. Features, commands, and systems may evolve as development continues.
